recovery_result.conclusion: No missed alert can be proven from surviving timestamp evidence. However, the extraordinary recovery surfaced three live, strongly matching Madrid roles whose stable IDs were absent from the ledger before recovery. Two Cabify roles are probable missed-alert candidates and the J&J role is a possible missed-alert candidate; all should be surfaced immediately rather than waiting for another radar cycle.

ledger_reconciliation.reason: The monolithic shared ledger was not rewritten during the architecture freeze/recovery pass. This report is the durable evidence record for the newly surfaced stable IDs until safe ledger reconciliation is performed.
